title: Which Group Has More Flowers?
description: Compare groups of two and four. Join Pip Bunny and Tilly Turtle in an original animated story from Little Wonder Friends.
learning_goal: Compare groups of two and four.

selection.reason: No authenticated discovery client; evergreen fallback

scenes.narration: Pip puts two flowers on one side of his picture.
Tilly puts four flowers on the other side of the picture.
Which group has more flowers? Let's count each group with care.
Two on Pip's side, and four on Tilly's side: four is more.
Counting helps us compare, and every flower makes their picture lovely.
